summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Comfort Wiring Neo cycle 2 features: consent history, scoped grants, provider auth, and projection filtering. Backend APIs fully functional (27/27 node tests pass, 23/23 Python tests pass). Frontend mostly functional with one minor issue in patient registration form.

ui_bugs.issue: Patient registration form does not redirect to /portal after successful account creation. Form submission appears to complete (fields are filled, button is clicked) but page remains on /signin. Provider registration works correctly with identical pattern.
ui_bugs.workaround: Patient registration API works correctly (returns 201 with token). Issue is frontend-only. Provider registration form works correctly, suggesting issue is specific to patient signin component or routing.
